New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force sisih-agent | Out-Null
Set-Location sisih-agent
Remove-Item Env:SISIH_OWNER_TOKEN, Env:SISIH_OWNER_MCP_TOKEN, Env:DEMO_TOKEN, Env:OWNER_PRIVATE_KEY -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$env:SISIH_AGENT_TOKEN = "<private Mainnet agent credential>"

$options = @('exec', '--ignore-user-config', '--ignore-rules', '--skip-git-repo-check', '--ephemeral', '--sandbox', 'read-only', '--disable', 'shell_tool', '--disable', 'unified_exec', '--disable', 'apps', '--disable', 'plugins', '--disable', 'hooks', '--disable', 'browser_use', '--disable', 'computer_use', '--disable', 'view_image', '-c', 'approval_policy=never', '-c', 'web_search=disabled', '-c', 'mcp_servers.sisih.url=https://sisih-azure.vercel.app/api/mcp', '-c', 'mcp_servers.sisih.bearer_token_env_var=SISIH_AGENT_TOKEN', '-c', 'mcp_servers.sisih.default_tools_approval_mode=auto')
codex @options "Use the sisih MCP server to show the current Mainnet vault balance, protected commitments and permission state. List available services. Do not buy anything or change configuration."
